_readme: Copy to email-industry.json. Keys are industry.js labels. 'default' is used when the industry is unknown or has no entry. 'block' is the text that replaces {{industryBlock}} in the email (tokens like {{business}} work inside it). Leave a block empty to add nothing. Only real, approved material: a block starting with EXAMPLE is refused at send time.

HVAC.block: EXAMPLE: replace with a real one-liner + link (one-pager / case study) for HVAC pros.

Plumbing.block: EXAMPLE: replace with a real one-liner + link (one-pager / case study) for Plumbing pros.

Cleaning.block: EXAMPLE: replace with a real one-liner + link (one-pager / case study) for Cleaning pros.
